name: Zhou Yemang
bio: Ye Mang has studied in the acting department of the Shanghai Theater Academy. His representative works include the dramas "Sunrise", "Chinese Dream" and "The Republic Will Not Forget", etc., and the TV series "Water Margin", "Red Item Merchant Hu Xueyan", "We Dad, Mom, Sixty Years ", etc., movies" Hua Jia Tears "," Wind Moon "and so on. He also participated in the dubbing of films such as "Growing Trouble", and hosted programs such as "Steam God of Food" and "Beauty Pass".
